pr_title: Add `--json` export flag for workflow runs
pr_body:
This PR adds JSON export functionality to `gh run list` and `gh run view`:

Examples:

`ghd run list -L 1 --json headSha,headBranch,workflowDatabaseId,databaseId`

``` json
[
  {
    "databaseId": 1227385157,
    "headBranch": "run-json-format",
    "headSha": "6ab9ab8a3c113afa459e9acae393ac35ecc68d85",
    "workflowDatabaseId": 25016
  }
]

```
`ghd run view 964177659 --json headSha,headBranch,workflowDatabaseId,databaseId`
```json
{
  "databaseId": 964177659,
  "headBranch": "draft-flow-gh-repo-edit",
  "headSha": "055bf84069f8e83986e215c388de2af45e65b0a9",
  "workflowDatabaseId": 1208059
}
```

Closes #3477
pr_comments: Is this feature being built? :D I was thinking about doing a tiny automation using the `gh run list` command and noticed it didn't have the `--json` flag. I guess I could use the GH API for now
Hi @karuppiah7890, will see if I can update this PR this weekend :)
Any ETA on when this will be merged?
@cristiand391 any chance of you adding HeadCommit/commit message as a json field? filtering on it is quite important in our workflow

Hey @kirikorneev! Sorry for the delayed response, it seems the Run struct [already defines a `HeadCommit` field](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/c9f44ffda9f9ff77820e5dda9b7b8885ad2136d7/pkg/cmd/run/shared/shared.go#L71) but it isn't exposed as a json field yet.

The field `headCommit` should be added to this [array](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/c9f44ffda9f9ff77820e5dda9b7b8885ad2136d7/pkg/cmd/run/shared/shared.go#L46), that way the `--json` flag will take that value and the export data method will add it to the json object.
Keep in mind that the type of the `HeadCommit` only exposes a `Message` field, that's the one you are requesting but if you need the whole `head_commit` object that the API provides you will need to add those fields here: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/c9f44ffda9f9ff77820e5dda9b7b8885ad2136d7/pkg/cmd/run/shared/shared.go#L84

Could you please open a new issue in this repo? That way you can get feedback/approval from the maintainers to add expose this new field.

Thanks!

issue_context.title: Allow `--json` on the run command
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

Currently the CLI has the ability for the `issues` and `pullrequests` to output as json (https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/385), this is not included in the run command

e.g: `gh run list --json`

### Proposed solution

Giving a structured output that does not need libraries like `awk` to pull out the valid data is helpful in many automation cases (i.e see the output of a run to use in an automation script). Adding `--json` will make this vastly easier

### Additional Context

I looked through the current issues and did not find an issue that specifically for this, apologies if I missed one
comments:
We should definitely do this.

@mislav do you want to continue to take point on this type of work or is there enough prior art given the recent release to mark this as `help-wanted`?

I'm marking this `help-wanted`.

Here's an example of how `release view --json` handles exporting data: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/4d20aa78733aa1e6f8c8d35dd27e9b4979ae4e6f/pkg/cmd/release/view/view.go#L111-L113

Someone could add this to `run list` function and pass in the `[]shared.Run` slice as data to be exported. The final bit would be defining a `shared.Run.ExportData()` so that a Run object can be converted into data that is to be serialized as JSON for output: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/4d20aa78733aa1e6f8c8d35dd27e9b4979ae4e6f/pkg/cmd/release/shared/fetch.go#L77-L77
